title: Add a results table to a document
oracle_notes: booktabs table in the right place with its caption above, right-aligned numbers and a working reference; rows are read from the rendered page; the other text unchanged.

title: Table with grouped headers
oracle_notes: multicolumn group headers with cmidrules, multirow; rows read from the rendered page; bold exactly on 0.42, 1.71, 8.15 and 64.3 (the faster time per row).

title: Fix a table that runs off the page
oracle_notes: tabularx or p columns; no overfull boxes and every word inside the margins in the PDF. Scaling, makebox, landscape, tiny fonts and changed margins are rejected.

title: Typeset mathematics from plain text
oracle_notes: Four numbers exactly: (1) pde, (2) bc, (3) source, (4) weak form, the last on the second line of its align. The stiffness matrix display is unnumbered.

title: Repair a broken document
oracle_notes: Ten faults: geometry brace, grid_size, 50% (silently drops text), &, itemize/enumerate mismatch, misspelled sec:setup label, unclosed \\frac, missing graphicx, label before caption (Figure prints the section number), literal $.

title: Theorem environments and cross-references
oracle_notes: amsthm with one shared section-numbered counter, definition style for the definition, hyperref before cleveref, cleveref printing the type names.

title: Side-by-side subfigures
oracle_notes: subcaption, two subfigure environments; (a) and (b) on one line in the PDF; references print Figure 1a and 1b.

title: Algorithm pseudocode
oracle_notes: PCG: alpha = r^T z / p^T A p, x += alpha p, r -= alpha A p, z = M^-1 r, beta = new r^T z / old r^T z, p = z + beta p. Math is checked by heuristics; a judge should confirm it.

title: TikZ flowchart
oracle_notes: Six named nodes and six arrows (with the loop refine to assemble). The nodes' real boxes come from a probe compile, so overlaps are measured. Judge: the back edge shouldn't cross nodes.

title: TikZ weighted graph and its spanning tree
oracle_notes: MST (Kruskal): a-c 2, c-e 3, a-b 4, d-f 6, d-e 7, total 22. b-c 5 would close a cycle.

title: TikZ geometry: exact coordinates
oracle_notes: With r = 2 cm and 30 degrees: P = (1.732, 1), Q = (1.732, 0), A = (2, 0), T = (2, 1.1547). Positions measured by the probe compile, tolerance 0.1 mm.

title: pgfplots convergence plot
oracle_notes: Reference line: y = 1.55 h^2, through (0.2, 6.2e-2). All twelve data values must appear in the axis.
